# Stage182 — exact full-real interval in external N14 ternary IID model

**Status:** author-level exact mathematics and computations; not formal Source Result, independent Driver acceptance, or native P000/X6 theorem. Frozen GLOBAL_KNOWLEDGE_V1 main@60adb778fcdb6ae2ba67e6587d70da0903abb4df; EM main@f7fcedbcc780d4bc445f1be86002f88aae7ece97; predecessor Stage181 40cb6be765ae554e25262c166c705bd53694c9e3.

## Statement

Observations i.i.d. under P=(1/8,1/24,5/6) or Q=(1/12,1/12,5/6) on alphabet {0,1,2}; N=14. Policies may randomize stopping and deciding P/Q based on **entire ordered history** and stop by N. Let eP=P(decide Q), eQ=Q(decide P), tP=E_P tau, tQ=E_Q tau. Define V14(alpha) as the minimum of max(tP,tQ) among rules with eP,eQ <= alpha.

alpha181=6284207827044845991787/17990936586642819907584;
V181=51102151300350906677021/4497734146660704976896;
Delta182=86565500809375/162678463059197952;
K182=1611037442739/7914560074;
L182=2382620124632/11871840111;
M182=K182+L182=9598352577481/23743680222.

**Theorem:** For **every real** delta with 0<=delta<=Delta182, including irrational delta,

    V14(alpha181+delta) = V181 - M182 * delta.

The new right endpoint is

    alpha182=6293781278910356391787/17990936586642819907584
    V182=50134637360540821877021/4497734146660704976896.

This theorem concerns the external finite IID stopping problem, not unbounded horizon or P000 native dynamics.

## Full-history Bellman lower bound

At count state x=(n,a,b), with a zeros and b ones, likelihood ratio Q(path)/P(path)=ell(x)=2^(a+b)/3^a. For fixed K=K182 and L=L182 the P-weighted objective J=tP+K eQ+L eP has exact recurrence

    B(x) = min{K ell(x), L, 1+sum_i P_i B(x_i)}  if n<14,
    B(x) = min{K ell(x), L}                       if n=14.

The actions mean decide P, decide Q, continue. Backward induction lower bounds **all full-history randomized policies** because their conditional continuation value is a convex combination bounded below by this state recurrence. Sum_{n=0}^{14} binom(n+2,2)=680 states. Exact fractions enumerate precisely two ties T=(7,2,0) P/continue, S=(9,0,1) Q/continue. The other 1,238 action gaps are strictly positive, minimum 5158086907/213693121998. Root:

    H=B(0,0,0)=99220133687154264151917824735/650345588338548699933179904.

Hence for every alpha-feasible strategy,

    max(tP,tQ)>=tP>=H-K*eQ-L*eP>=H-(K+L)*alpha.

## A primal strategy attaining the bound for all real parameters

Use strict Bellman minimizers outside S and T. At S decide Q with probability s (otherwise continue); at T decide P with probability t (otherwise continue). These states cannot be ancestors of each other: T already has two zeros, but S has none; S is at n=9, later than T at n=7. Thus no history visits both states; each of (eP,eQ,tP,tQ) is affine in s,t with no mixed term.

All four deterministic corners were evaluated independently by Fraction suffix DP and full unmerged ordered-history integer-weight DFS under P and Q, obtaining exactly equal vectors. The DFS node counts for corners 00,01,10,11 are 244078,238912,243646,238480, total **965116**. First-hit S has 9 ordered paths, P-mass 390625/4478976 and Q-mass 390625/2239488; first-hit T has 21 paths, P-mass 21875/165888 and Q-mass 21875/373248.

Solving eP=eQ exactly gives

    s(t)=6103153750279349/37833811200000000
         +(411561059/985255500)*t.

For **every real** t in [0,1] both coins are legal, since s(0)>0 and s(1)=21907098415879349/37833811200000000<1. At t=0 the errors and P time are exactly alpha181,alpha181,V181 and the S coin matches the Stage181 right endpoint. At t=1 errors and P time are alpha182,alpha182,V182. All observables are affine, alpha strictly increases and tP decreases, so every real alpha in between is attained. Exact positive tP-tQ margins are, at the two ends,

    left=186877295703571825295/562216768332588122112
    right=166057085648349625295/562216768332588122112.

Therefore max(tP,tQ)=tP on the entire interval. All actions minimize Bellman, so tP+K eQ+L eP=H, yielding equality in the lower bound; this proves the theorem for all reals, not just a grid.

## Strict right support boundary

Finite alphabet and finite horizon make the randomized full-history policy space compact and observables continuous. If equality with the same affine lower line were possible at alpha>alpha182, then K,L>0 would force eP=eQ=alpha and each reached decision would be Bellman minimizing. All strictly positive gaps force non-tie actions. Arbitrary history-dependent coins at S and T reduce to two effective aggregate coin probabilities under both laws because Q/P likelihood ratio is constant over paths arriving at the same fixed count state. Also S and T never co-occur on a path. Thus any support-equality policy has the same observables as two coins (s,t) in [0,1]^2. Error balance enforces the above s(t), whose alpha value is strictly increasing and maximized at t=1, exactly alpha182. Contradiction; by attainment, V14 is **strictly above this same Stage182 support line** to the right.

## Observer/BRC boundaries, verification and next question

BRC reuse classification REUSE_APPLIED: positive rational labeled ordered-path carrier, multiplicity and separate P/Q branch masses retained by integer-weight DFS, with no signed/phase cancellation. Count-state suffix compression is justified for the declared finite IID observer, not an unrestricted path equivalence or native X6/Heartbeat result. Native BRC-Shor arithmetic is not invoked for this external probability model.

Exact local executed originals VERIFY_STAGE182.py and SCAN_STAGE183.py passed. Repository reference scripts were source-derived from the published Stage181 references and are **not byte-identical to executed originals**; actual originals, stdout, full certificate and SHA256 manifest are in the accompanying Stage182 portable research ZIP. GitHub storage/readback does not imply GitHub execution. Stage183 dual-only frontier: K=2983556187/15076502, L=1477646456/7538251, H=61508771764230260243523613/412949318370301380132864. New ties S=(9,0,1) Q/continue and X=(11,5,2) P/continue, 1238 strict gaps, min 5926103/180918024. Its primal real interval is unproved; next solve the exact S/X four-corner observer and admissible coin range.
